spine.title: React Foundations
spine.description: The essential building blocks every React app is built on — JSX syntax, function components, props, and local state.

spine.title: Core Hooks
spine.description: The built-in hooks that power side effects, DOM access, and performance in function components.

children.title: useEffect
children.description: Run side effects after render: data fetching, subscriptions, DOM mutations. The cleanup function prevents memory leaks.

children.title: useRef
children.description: A mutable ref that persists across renders without triggering re-render. Used for DOM access and storing previous values.

children.title: Memoization
children.description: Stabilize references and skip expensive recalculations across renders.

children.title: useCallback
children.description: Memoize a callback so its reference stays stable. Prevents unnecessary child re-renders.

children.title: useMemo
children.description: Memoize the result of an expensive computation. Recalculates only when dependencies change.

children.title: useContext
children.description: Consume a context value without prop drilling. Pairs with createContext and a Provider component.

children.title: useReducer
children.description: Manage complex state with a reducer function and dispatch/actions pattern — the same model as Redux, built-in.

spine.title: Component Patterns
spine.description: Composition and rendering techniques that make components flexible and reusable.

children.title: Conditional Rendering
children.description: Render UI conditionally using &&, ternary operators, or early return.

children.title: Lists & Keys
children.description: Render arrays with Array.map(). The key prop helps React identify which items changed.

children.title: Fragments
children.description: Group multiple elements without adding extra DOM nodes. Use <> shorthand or <React.Fragment> with a key.

children.title: Portals
children.description: Render a child into a DOM node outside the parent hierarchy. Useful for modals, tooltips, and dropdowns.

children.title: Error Boundaries
children.description: Catch rendering errors in a subtree and show a fallback UI instead of crashing the whole app.

spine.title: State Management
spine.description: Patterns and libraries for sharing and scaling state across the component tree.

children.title: Context API
children.description: Built-in global state sharing. Great for low-frequency updates like theme or auth.

children.title: External Stores
children.description: Dedicated state libraries that avoid Context re-render pitfalls at scale.

children.title: Zustand
children.description: Lightweight store with minimal boilerplate. Subscribe only to the slices you need.

children.title: Redux Toolkit
children.description: The modern, opinionated way to write Redux. Slices, createAsyncThunk, and RTK Query.

children.title: Jotai
children.description: Atomic state management — each piece of state is an independent atom.

spine.title: Data Fetching
spine.description: Strategies for loading server data, managing async state, and keeping the UI in sync.

children.title: React Query
children.description: Server state management: caching, background refetching, and stale-while-revalidate out of the box.

children.title: Suspense
children.description: Declarative async UI. Wrap async components with <Suspense fallback={...}> to show a loader until data is ready.

children.title: use() hook
children.description: React 19's new hook to read a Promise or Context inside a component. Replaces some useEffect data-fetching patterns.

children.title: SWR
children.description: Vercel's stale-while-revalidate data-fetching library. Similar to React Query but more minimal.

spine.title: Performance
spine.description: Techniques to avoid unnecessary renders and keep large React apps fast.

children.title: React.memo
children.description: Wrap a component to skip re-rendering when props haven't changed.

children.title: Code Splitting
children.description: Split the bundle at route or component boundaries to reduce initial load.

children.title: lazy + Suspense
children.description: Code-split any component so its bundle loads on demand. Combine with Suspense for seamless loading.

children.title: Concurrent Features
children.description: React 18+ APIs that keep the UI responsive during expensive updates.

children.title: useTransition
children.description: Mark a state update as non-urgent so React keeps the UI responsive during expensive re-renders.

children.title: useDeferredValue
children.description: Defer re-rendering a part of the UI. The React 18+ answer to debouncing renders.

children.title: Profiler
children.description: Measure render performance with React DevTools Profiler or the <Profiler> API component.

spine.title: Routing
spine.description: Client-side navigation, route structure, and URL-driven state.

children.title: React Router v6
children.description: Client-side routing with a declarative nested routes API. createBrowserRouter is the recommended setup.

children.title: Nested Routes
children.description: Child routes render inside a parent's <Outlet>. Enables shared layouts and URL-driven composition.

children.title: Route Guards (loaders)
children.description: v6.4+ loaders run before a route renders — ideal for auth checks and data pre-loading.

children.title: useNavigate & hooks
children.description: Programmatic navigation with useNavigate, and read URL state with useParams, useSearchParams, useLocation.

spine.title: Forms
spine.description: Build and validate user input workflows in React.

children.title: Controlled Inputs
children.description: React owns the input value via state. Every keystroke calls setState — the single source of truth.

children.title: React Hook Form
children.description: Performant forms with uncontrolled inputs and minimal re-renders. register, watch, handleSubmit, formState.

children.title: Zod Validation
children.description: Schema-first runtime validation. Pairs with React Hook Form's resolver for type-safe forms.

spine.title: Testing
spine.description: Validate component behavior from the user's perspective with modern testing tools.

children.title: React Testing Library
children.description: Test components from the user's perspective. Query by role, label, or text — not implementation details.

children.title: Vitest
children.description: Vite-native test runner. Faster than Jest in a Vite project, same @testing-library API.

children.title: user-event
children.description: Simulate realistic browser interactions (click, type, tab) rather than low-level fireEvent calls.

children.title: MSW
children.description: Mock Service Worker intercepts real network requests in tests and the browser — no need to mock fetch/axios.

spine.title: Ecosystem & Tooling
spine.description: The tools and frameworks that surround React in a modern production stack.

children.title: Vite
children.description: Next-generation build tool. Native ESM dev server, extremely fast HMR, Rollup-based production builds.

children.title: TypeScript
children.description: Static typing for React: type props with interfaces, narrow event types, catch bugs at compile time.

children.title: Tailwind CSS
children.description: Utility-first CSS. Tailwind v4 drops the config file — just @import 'tailwindcss' in your CSS entry point.

children.title: Next.js 15
children.description: React framework with SSR, SSG, App Router, and React Server Components.

children.title: Turborepo
children.description: High-performance monorepo build system. Caches task outputs and runs pipelines in parallel.
